overall_summary: The site lacks fundamental content and navigation elements, creating major friction, unclear messaging, and trust gaps for first‑time visitors.

findings.title: Missing page title
findings.interpretation: Without a title, visitors receive no immediate value proposition and search engines have no context, reducing perceived relevance.
findings.hypothesis: First‑time users may leave the page within seconds because they cannot quickly understand what the site offers.
findings.recommendation: Add a concise, benefit‑focused title that communicates the core offering.

findings.title: No clear calls to action
evidence: Only a generic "Learn more" link is present.
findings.interpretation: Visitors have no obvious next step, leading to indecision and abandonment.
findings.hypothesis: Conversion rates will remain low because users cannot identify the primary action you want them to take.
findings.recommendation: Introduce a prominent primary CTA button above the fold that directs to the desired conversion point.
findings.suggested_change: Add a button with text "Get Started" linking to /signup

findings.title: Absent navigation menu
findings.interpretation: Users cannot explore other pages or locate information, increasing bounce likelihood.
findings.hypothesis: Visitors may exit the site rather than searching for missing navigation links.
findings.recommendation: Implement a top navigation bar with key sections.
findings.suggested_change: Add nav items: Home, Features, Pricing, Contact

findings.title: Lack of trust signals
evidence: No testimonials, badges, or client logos present.
findings.interpretation: The page provides no evidence of credibility or security, which can cause hesitation.
findings.hypothesis: Potential customers may doubt legitimacy and postpone or abandon the conversion.
findings.recommendation: Add trust badges, customer logos, or short testimonial snippets.
findings.suggested_change: Insert "Trusted by 1,000+ companies" and security badge icons near the CTA

top_3_priorities: Add a clear primary call‑to‑action button
Create a concise, benefit‑focused page title
